models.note: The model block records the INTENDED costed-pass configuration (the same answerer + cross-MODEL judge pair as the 2026-05-31-j1-baseline). The KEYLESS Wave-1 re-measurement that backs this manifest calls NO model: the judge is an injected deterministic verdict stub, the competitor presence probe defaults to () => false, and the sole adapter that runs is the pure letta-fs control. cross-PROVIDER judging with claude-opus-4-8 is the costed re-run — opus is used as a judge ONLY when the answer lane is non-Anthropic (BUG-004: an answerer must never be its own provider's judge).

measurementsTaken.name: recall-learning rankLift (positive direction)
measurementsTaken.result: 2/2 PASS — rankLift = firstRank - lastRank is positive (the gold doc climbs the ranked order as the FEED usefulness signal accrues across episodes). Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: redaction leak-rate ON <= OFF
measurementsTaken.result: 2/2 PASS — scoreOn.leakRate <= scoreOff.leakRate (the write-time validator + recall-time scrubber never increase the leak-rate). Deterministic string check, no LLM. Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: append-only never-overwrite ledger MECHANISM
measurementsTaken.result: 7/7 PASS — a 2nd write to the same dated path is REFUSED and the first file's bytes stay byte-identical; a different-date row coexists; the keyless run writes NO row to benchmarks/results/history/. The MECHANISM is proven over a fresh tmp dir; the real dated append is the operator-costed pass.

measurementsTaken.name: ablation off = byte-identity for all 5 v2.8 factors
measurementsTaken.result: 7/7 PASS — all 5 factors (lanes.graphSpread.enabled; mmr.enabled; queryUnderstanding.intentReweight; queryUnderstanding.temporalParse; write-side memoryReasoning.enabled) are byte-identical to the baseline when toggled OFF — a mistyped knob leaf would diverge.

measurementsTaken.result: 7/7 PASS — the fold survives 3/4 categories (single-session-preference 30-vs-45 = 15pt flagged UNSTABLE) + significance never-NaN; mem0 skip-with-disclosure carries NO numeric field; the letta-fs control ran (isControl); a real Comis recall cell with the v2.8 lanes ON returned ranked results (lanes wired, not dormant). These are INJECTED verdicts proving the FOLD, NOT a measured cross-judged number.

measurementsTaken.result: SKIPPED with a logged note (~2h it budget for the 1M-token ingest; BEAM measures recall@k only, never bytes/footprint — so the FORGET-scope finding is static regardless of running it). COMIS_BENCH_BEAM_10M never set.

measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.name: fresh cross-judged QA accuracy refresh
measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.why: Needs the judge API -> real spend. A keyless run produces no QA accuracy (there is no judge on that path); a fresh accuracy number would be fabricated. Re-state the committed prior number OR mark not-measured.
measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.reproductionCommand: scripts/bench-memory.sh gate with a populated bench-memory.env (answer + 2 judges)

measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.name: competitor head-to-head (mem0 / zep / hindsight / mnemosyne)
measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.why: Each competitor adapter is a skip-with-disclosure skeleton: mem0/zep need an external package + a hosted credential, hindsight/mnemosyne are sibling clones the operator builds. NONE is a Comis dependency (the exact-pin + bundling supply-chain invariant). The keyless CI always hits the skip branch (that IS the wiring proof). A real competitor cell needs the operator's installs + credentials + LLM judge spend; a vendor self-reported number is non-comparable across protocols (the COI).
measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.reproductionCommand: populate scripts/bench-memory.env (answer + 2 judge providers) + install the competitor systems, then scripts/bench-memory.sh gate

coi.disclosure: Comis authored this benchmark suite and proving machine. Vendor-reported competitor numbers are NON-COMPARABLE across protocols and harnesses; competitors are invited to reproduce on their own harness. No competitor number, no cross-judged delta, and no superiority-comparison framing appears anywhere in this manifest (binding constraint #8). The letta-fs filesystem-tool baseline is recorded ONLY as a labelled control, never as Comis's score.
coi.ossLicense: Apache-2.0 harness — the proving harness (head-to-head.bench.test.ts) and every Wave-1 module carry an SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 header so the protocol is independently reproducible.
coi.rawTranscriptRelease: On the operator-costed re-run, the raw answer + judge transcripts are released alongside the dated row under benchmarks/results/history/<date>-<commit>.json (one immutable dated row per release) so any number is auditable end-to-end.

honestyProtocol: Every number traces to a committed JSON/manifest, read back from disk before quoting. No cross-judged number is quoted that was not produced by a real invalid==0 run — the fresh cross-judged QA-accuracy refresh + the competitor head-to-head are explicitly 'not measured — operator costed re-run', NOT a guessed delta. The keyless mechanical re-measurement (rankLift sign, ON<=OFF leak-rate, never-overwrite ledger, off=byte-identity, the 3/4 fold) is kept STRICTLY SEPARATE from the re-stated cross-judged QA accuracy and is each labelled 'mechanical, keyless, $0 — not a QA-accuracy lift'. A post-run credential-shape sweep over the manifest is clean: it carries pure numbers + booleans + prose, no credential field names or secret-key/bearer-token shapes.
